dimensions.mission: Useful saved observations become source-bound advisory fragments without strategy promotion.
dimensions.research_truth: Original result, condition, target, negative findings and Scout adaptive exposure retained; monitoring exploratory.
dimensions.owner_operability: Existing /research and one native read/preview/apply/run-due CLI; no UI effects.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Actual completed import hook; native pending/reservations and result-link recovery; no new scheduler.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One task contract and one source snapshot; ordinary bounded capsule closure, no archive dump.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Prospective plan revision, stable native journal across epochs; no refund or retrospective schedule rewrite.
dimensions.security: Exact root/source/code binding and current native protection before values.
dimensions.red_team: Missing protection, invalid source, resource bound, same-window ownership, cutoff and crash proof.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: ADOPT ResearchStore, projection, ordinary accounting and native evaluator; no dependency.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Research advisory only; no trading, strategy composition, deploy or executable-return claim.

capability_radar.watch: No new tool or service needed.

recovery: Disable exact plan via native preview/apply; preserve every artifact and native charge. Ordinary code revert only; no canonical data removal.
